# San Antonio Public Adjuster

> Licensed Texas public adjusting (Rise Public Adjusting LLC, TDI license #3356839) for homeowners and business owners in San Antonio, Bexar County, and surrounding communities. We represent policyholders, not insurance companies, on hail, wind, flood, freeze, fire, smoke, and water damage claims.

Phone: +1 (832) 503-5866 · Email: info@publicadjustersanantonio.com · Joseph Dittman, licensed Texas public adjuster: jditt@risepublicadjusting.com
